summary: On 31 July 2024 in Ilagan City, Isabela, Morine "G." Cabansag, 40, was found dead in a cemetery after an alleged kidnapping and rape in Centro San Antonio; three suspects were identified. The monitored trans-murder count records the cause as stabbing. This is one of six documented killings of trans women in eighteen months in the national series, with arrests made in at least three of them and none reported prosecuted to conviction. No protective ordinance, institutional-hostility finding or enforcement pattern specific to trans visitors is documented in this region beyond this single incident.
